facts.text: Andrew expressed enthusiasm about attending a pastry party and mentioned that his dogs would join.

evidence.quote: Awesome! My dogs will tag along. My furry friends would love it!
Definitely! They'll have a great time at the party! Can't wait for the party!

facts.text: Audrey mentioned that she made some of her favorite treats last week and suggested having a pastry party.

evidence.quote: Since you mentioned pastries, I made some of my favorite treats last week. Let's have a pastry party sometime!

facts.text: Audrey expressed excitement about the pastry party and mentioned that the dogs bring joy to her life.

evidence.quote: Yay! This'll be awesome! Seeing them all together, having fun and enjoying treats is the best. I can't imagine life without them, they bring so much joy.
